WITH inputs AS (
  SELECT
    (t.elem->>'firstName')::text AS first_name,
    (t.elem->>'lastName')::text  AS last_name,
    (t.elem->>'fullName')::text  AS full_name,
    (t.elem->>'email')::text     AS email,
    (t.ordinality - 1)::int      AS input_index
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS t(elem, ordinality)
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT
    i.input_index,
    ms.participant_id, ms.buyer_id, ms.trip_id,
    ms.first_name, ms.last_name, ms.email, ms.chapter_name, ms.status,
    at.trip_name, at.destination, at.start_date, at.end_date,
    CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(i.email, '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        CASE
          WHEN LOWER(ms.email) = LOWER(i.email) THEN 1.0
          ELSE similarity(
            LOWER(split_part(ms.email, '@', 1)),
            LOWER(split_part(i.email, '@', 1))
          )
        END
      WHEN NULLIF(i.full_name, '') IS NOT NULL THEN
        similarity(
          LOWER(COALESCE(ms.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ms.last_name, '')),
          LOWER(i.full_name)
        )
      ELSE NULL
    END AS match_score
  FROM inputs i
  JOIN master_sheet ms ON
    ms.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND (
      NULLIF(i.email, '') IS NULL
      OR LOWER(ms.email) = LOWER(i.email)
      OR (
        -- Domain-pinned fuzzy fallback for typo'd emails (e.g. missing 1-2 chars)
        LOWER(split_part(ms.email, '@', 2)) = LOWER(split_part(i.email, '@', 2))
        AND similarity(
          LOWER(split_part(ms.email, '@', 1)),
          LOWER(split_part(i.email, '@', 1))
        ) > 0.5
      )
    )
    AND (NULLIF(i.first_name, '') IS NULL OR ms.first_name ILIKE '%' || i.first_name || '%')
    AND (NULLIF(i.last_name,  '') IS NULL OR ms.last_name  ILIKE '%' || i.last_name  || '%')
    AND (
      NULLIF(i.full_name, '') IS NULL
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(ms.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ms.last_name, ''))
         ILIKE '%' || LOWER(i.full_name) || '%'
      OR similarity(
        LOWER(COALESCE(ms.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ms.last_name, '')),
        LOWER(i.full_name)
      ) > 0.3
    )
  LEFT JOIN all_trips at ON ms.trip_id = at.trip_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY input_index
      ORDER BY COALESCE(match_score, 0) DESC, last_name NULLS LAST, first_name NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT
  input_index    AS "inputIndex",
  participant_id AS "participantId",
  buyer_id       AS "buyerId",
  trip_id        AS "tripId",
  first_name     AS "firstName",
  last_name      AS "lastName",
  email,
  chapter_name   AS "chapterName",
  status,
  trip_name      AS "tripName",
  destination,
  start_date     AS "startDate",
  end_date       AS "endDate",
  match_score    AS "matchScore"
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 20
ORDER BY input_index, COALESCE(match_score, 0) DESC, last_name NULLS LAST, first_name NULLS LAST

WITH q AS (
  SELECT TRIM($1::text) AS query_text
),
deduped AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (LOWER(ms.email))
    ms.participant_id,
    ms.buyer_id,
    ms.trip_id,
    ms.first_name,
    ms.last_name,
    ms.email,
    ms.chapter_name,
    ms.status,
    GREATEST(
      similarity(
        LOWER(COALESCE(ms.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ms.last_name, '')),
        LOWER((SELECT query_text FROM q))
      ),
      similarity(LOWER(ms.email), LOWER((SELECT query_text FROM q)))
    ) AS match_score
  FROM master_sheet ms, q
  WHERE ms.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND ms.email IS NOT NULL AND ms.email <> ''
    AND ms.trip_id IS NOT NULL AND ms.trip_id <> ''
    AND ms.buyer_id IS NOT NULL AND ms.buyer_id <> ''
    AND length(q.query_text) >= 2
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(ms.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ms.last_name, ''))
        ILIKE '%' || LOWER(q.query_text) || '%'
      OR LOWER(ms.email) ILIKE '%' || LOWER(q.query_text) || '%'
      OR similarity(
           LOWER(COALESCE(ms.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ms.last_name, '')),
           LOWER(q.query_text)
         ) > 0.3
    )
  ORDER BY
    LOWER(ms.email),
    GREATEST(
      similarity(
        LOWER(COALESCE(ms.first_name, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(ms.last_name, '')),
        LOWER(q.query_text)
      ),
      similarity(LOWER(ms.email), LOWER(q.query_text))
    ) DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
  participant_id AS "participantId",
  buyer_id       AS "buyerId",
  trip_id        AS "tripId",
  first_name     AS "firstName",
  last_name      AS "lastName",
  email,
  chapter_name   AS "chapterName",
  match_score    AS "matchScore"
FROM deduped
ORDER BY match_score DESC NULLS LAST, last_name NULLS LAST, first_name NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20
